reviews.title: Misleading Trial and Disappointing Refund Experience
reviews.text:
I signed up for the 1-week trial (with 3 free days) to see if this app could help free up storage on my iPhone. After trying it on the first day, I found that it offered very limited help. It didn’t actually clean up my storage automatically—I still had to go through my photos and files one by one myself. Since it wasn’t useful for me, I canceled the subscription on the first day.

Even though I canceled immediately, I was still charged through the Apple App Store, and my refund request was denied. I understand that Apple processes subscriptions, but the overall experience felt misleading. The charge wasn’t a large amount, but I expected that canceling so early during what was advertised as a trial would prevent unexpected charges.

The app didn’t save me time, and the subscription experience left a very negative impression.
